page.layout: One page of text, full width, set in large roman type. Below the text: a bold-capitals closing line, an italic line with the signature, and a small signature line. At the lower right: the catchword "PRÆ-". No margin notes.

main_text.p: olim & hodie conjuncto. Atque ita eâdem , quâ tenuiora quondam mea, hanc qualemcunq; etiam disquisitionem, ma nu capessitote. Valete, AM. PLISSIMI VIRI , Vobis, Reipublicæ , Academiæ, Familiisq; Vestris. Dabam Heidelbergæ , Kalend. Septembr. Anno Æræ Christianæ MDCLVIII.

page.notes: The word "manu" is printed with a raised, smaller "a" above the line between "m" and "nu"; I have written it as "ma nu" to show the separation. The printed "ss" in "capessitote" is a long-s ligature, transcribed as plain "ss". The date "CIↃ IↄC LVIII" is read as MDCLVIII (1658) on the printed old-form numerals. Some specks and ink marks on the scan were ignored.
